BL-1352 — The unanswered-question escalation has never delivered: an unconfigured transport degrades to a status key nothing reads and 7027 identical log lines
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-03 by the specifier, from evidence read off disk this pass,
not recalled:
- `.swarmforge/operator/status.json` -> `"ask_escalation":{"transport":"unconfigured"}`
- operator log: first `ask-escalation WARN ops issue unconfigured - no stamp`
  at 2026-08-30T06:36:32.269Z, 7027 lines to…
Approval context: GH-25 shipped an escalation that has never fired once. It needs a GitHub ops issue number to post its mention to, that number ships commented out in swarmforge.conf (`# config ask_escalation_issue 25`), the env override is unset, and GH-25 specced a missing value to degrade quietly rather than cras…
BL-1352 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1352" (or "reject BL-1352 <reason>") to act.
